I'm Con, a data scientist based in London. I started out in physics, and these days I build optimisation, language and forecasting models for a living. This site is where I write up what I build in my own time.

## What you'll find here

- Write-ups of personal data science and ML engineering projects: what I built, what went wrong, and what I'd change.
- The odd post on a mathematics or programming problem I found interesting.
